{{Quote|The m'iiyoom is the white flower that blossoms in the season of trine, the season when all three moons give their light. It's also called the nightlily.|[[M'iiyoom Onith]]|audio=Miiyoom-Nightlily.flac|<ref name="audio">[[Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale (audio drama)|"Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Trine''' was a [[Season/Legends|season]] on [[H'nemthe/Legends|H'nemthe]],<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> an [[Forest/Legends|arboreal]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> that experienced extreme weather fluctuations as a result of the collective [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] force of its three [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The [[m'iiyoom]], a [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Flower/Legends|flower]] native to H'nemthe, blossomed in the season of trine, during which all three of the planet's moons gave their light.<ref name="Nightlily" />
